# netactuate_firewall_rules (Data Source)

Reads Firewall Rules visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_firewall_rules" "example" {
  firewall_set_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `firewall_set_id` (Number) Firewall set ID whose rules will be listed

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rules` (List of Object) List of rules in the firewall set (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
